Builds gas ×2, ALGO payment to the registry, addStake, and optional reward-token opt-in. Enforces minEntryStake, capacity, and entry gates at quote time.

compatibleExitShapes.title: Réti ALGO unstake from pool
compatibleExitShapes.summary: Removes ALGO stake from a Réti staking pool via StakingPool.removeStake. Builds gas ×2, removeStake, and optional reward-token opt-in. Partial unstake must leave at least minEntryStake (or unstake the full balance).

data.notes: sourceTimestamp equals fetchedAt; upstream does not expose a per-row update timestamp. Réti validator 34; consensus APR net of 500 bps validator commission; sampleSize=32; pools=1; minEntryStake=1000000000 µALGO.
